name: 蔡德華
objective:
選修介紹材料通性、分類與應用，並深入高分子生成之聚合反應、反應機構、反應動力學、熱力學、聚合物之材料構造、聚合方法、分子量之測定、分子量分佈以及一般檢測高分子特性之技術。
This course is concerned primarily with the synthesis, properties, and technology of synthetic polymers. Topics include polymerization, structure and properties, characterization , and properties of commercial polymers
schedule:
1. Introduction to Polymers
2. Polymer Structure (Morphology)
3. Molecular Weight of Polymers
4. Naturally Occurring Polymers
5. Step-Reaction Polymerization (Polycondensation Reactions)
6. Ionic Chain Reaction and Complex Coordination Polymerization
7. Free Radical Chain Polymerization (Addition Polymerization)
8. Copolymerization
9. Organometallic and Metalloid Polymers
scorePolicy: 出席及上課情形，實施作業、二～四次左右之月考、期中考、期末考。
materials: Charles E. Carraher, Jr., "Introduction to Polymer Chemistry", 4th ed., 2017.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG3：良好健康和福祉（Good Health and Well-being）SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG17：夥伴關係（Partnerships for the Goals）
